kevin (partnerships): Quick thread  EdgePulse wants to send daily CSV bundles (gz) and may re-run exports. Need dedupe + reconcile plan before we start pilot. Anyone free for 10m? :clock10:
maya (ingest): Yes. For CSVs we need either a stable row_id per row or a deterministic fingerprint. Re-exports mean duplicates, so we should compare export_id + per-object checksum first.
rahul (billing): Billing needs a canonical partner_usage_id. Prefer partner_provided row_uuid. If absent, fingerprint works but must be identical across pipeline (ingest -> ledger -> invoicing).
emma (partner-eng): EdgePulse can include export_id immediately; row_uuid rollout will take ~2 sprints. They can include partner_sku mapping file too.
maya (ingest): Proposed quick contract:
- require export_id in CSV header and filename
- optional row_uuid column; if missing compute fingerprint = sha256(partner||customer||iso8601_ts||sku||units_norm)
- units_norm: round to 6 decimal places and strip trailing zeros
- verify S3 object checksum from partner-provided checksums.txt before processing
- dedupe TTL = 180 days, store keys in redis with partner prefix
- precedence: stream_events > row_uuid > fingerprint
rahul (billing): Also add partner config: source_priority (stream/csv) + reconciliation_window_days. Invoice generator must de-dupe on canonical id and log origin for audits.
kevin (partnerships): For re-exports: if export_id == last_seen_export_id and checksums match -> skip. If export_id new but rows overlap, apply upsert only when incoming_ts > stored_ts to avoid regressing earlier accepted rows.
emma (partner-eng): I'll ask EdgePulse for sample gz files, checksums.txt, and a short commit plan for row_uuid rollout. Also request UTC timestamps in ISO format.
ingest-bot: preflight: checksum-verify enabled. integration-tests: failing on locale decimal comma handling :wrench:
maya (ingest): I'll prototype fingerprint generator and a small dedupe store test by EOD Friday and post the staging link.
rahul (billing): I'll update the billing dedupe checklist and include a reconciliation playbook snippet for ops.
kevin (partnerships): Action: emma to collect samples; maya to prototype; rahul to update docs. We'll reconvene after staging run. Thanks. :thumbsup:
